# Capri Auto Works

> Walk-in auto repair shop and used car lot at 2005 Hanover Ave, Allentown, PA 18109. Repairs, Pennsylvania state inspections, emissions testing, and a free emissions diagnostic. No appointment needed.

- Website: https://www.capriautoworks.online/
- Phone: (484) 903-7452
- Address: 2005 Hanover Ave, Allentown, PA 18109
- Hours: Monday to Friday 9 AM to 6 PM; Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM; Sunday closed
- Appointments: not needed. First come, first served during shop hours.
- Serves drivers from Allentown, Bethlehem, Easton, Whitehall, Emmaus and Catasauqua.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/capriautoworks/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=8282412669277652845

## Services

- Auto repair: diagnostics and repairs, walk-in during shop hours.
- Pennsylvania state safety inspection.
- Pennsylvania emissions inspection.
- Free emissions diagnostic for a check engine light or a failed emissions test. This is separate from the state emissions inspection; call to ask what it covers.
- Used cars: sold from the lot at 2005 Hanover Ave. Inventory is not listed online; call or visit to see what is available.

## Common questions

- Do I need an appointment? No. Walk in during shop hours, or call ahead to check how busy the shop is.
- Is the emissions diagnostic the same as the emissions inspection? No. The diagnostic finds why a check engine light is on or why a car failed; the PA emissions inspection is the state test.
- Can I see used-car inventory online? No. Visit the lot or call.
- My car failed inspection somewhere else. Can Capri help? Yes. Bring the car and the failure report.
- Pricing: call the shop to confirm current pricing.
